name: T3 Code for iOS
desc: iPhone app that drives coding agents running on your machines.
desc_zh: 在 iPhone 上操控跑在你机器上的编程智能体的应用。
solves: An agent run you have to babysit at a desk is not really remote; the phone becomes the remote control for the session.
solves_zh: 要守在电脑前盯着的智能体运行算不上远程；手机成了会话的遥控器。
best_for: You started a long agent run and want to check on it from the couch.
best_for_zh: 你启动了一个很长的智能体任务，想在沙发上查看进度。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：A — Apple App Store listing; D — t3.codes）。 Official App Store record for "T3 Code - Remote Claude & more" by T3 Tools, Inc. (trackId 6787819824, version 2.3.0 at access time, current version released 2026-11-10). The t3.codes homepage links to iOS and Android builds. The ledger holds the desktop T3 Code@2026-03-02. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：形态枚举没有手机应用；账本里手机应用记为 web。厂商没有公布中文名，name_zh 按 name。档案 id 由 ios-t3-code 改为 t3-code-ios，与 cindy-ios 的写法一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6787819824&country=us
